test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All doors are locks.

Some doors are keys.

Conclusions:

(i) Some locks are keys.

(ii) Some keys are doors.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52b5a11eaac275828690982fcc417496549fed9d32e19bfe15402b5befe019e5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65ab2c77575e9f19b36a652468dde06b273ec3addc6dec7400b8870947bd64cd.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(i) Some locks are keys → **True **(As, All doors are locks, Some doors are keys. so, Some locks are keys holds true)

(ii) Some keys are doors → **True **(As, All doors are locks, Some doors are keys. so, Some keys are doors holds true)

Thus, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
